title: Halves and quarters with a pizza
examples: Which is bigger, a half or a quarter?
How many quarters make a whole?

explain.say: Imagine one pizza and two hungry friends. To be fair, you cut it into two equal pieces. Each piece is one half. Look at the pizza on the board: one of the two equal parts is shaded.

draw.text: Halves and quarters with a pizza

explain.say: Two halves make one whole pizza. Equal means the same size. If one piece is bigger, it is not a half! Can you draw a line to cut a circle in half?
Now four friends! Cut the pizza into four equal pieces. Each piece is one quarter. Look: one of four equal parts. Is a quarter bigger or smaller than a half?
Look at the two bars on the board. One half is bigger than one quarter. Sharing with more people means smaller pieces! Can you see which bar has more shaded?
Here is a cool fact: two quarters are the same as one half. Look, the shaded parts match! Fantastic! Challenge: fold a piece of paper into halves, then into quarters.

faq.a: A half is one of two equal parts. When you cut something into two pieces the same size, each piece is a half.
A quarter is one of four equal parts. Four quarters make one whole.

faq.q: Which is bigger, a half or a quarter?
faq.a: A half is bigger. When you share between more people, each piece gets smaller.
asks: Is a quarter bigger than a half?

faq.q: Why must the parts be equal?
faq.a: Halves and quarters only count if every piece is the same size. Unequal pieces are not fair, and they are not halves or quarters.
asks: Do halves have to be the same size?

faq.q: How can I practise fractions at home?
faq.a: Fold paper, or cut fruit or a sandwich with a grown-up. Say how many equal parts there are each time.

quiz.say: How many quarters make a whole?
quiz.show: How many quarters make a whole?
quiz.why: A quarter is one of four equal parts, so four quarters make a whole.

wrong.1: Two quarters make one half, not a whole.
wrong.2: Three quarters is one piece short of a whole.

quiz.why: A half is cut into fewer pieces, so each piece is bigger.

wrong.1: A quarter is smaller, because the whole is cut into four.
wrong.2: They are different sizes: two quarters fit inside one half.
